'''Erik Lonnquist''' (esports handle '''DoA'''; also published as '''ggDoA''') was a guest on [[Holotheatre]] season 3, episode 29, on 14 July 2022.<ref name="ht-doa">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wlwWvl1F-1s Star Wars CCG - Holotheatre S3 Ep 29: Calling All Commentators (Guest - @ggDoA)], Star Wars CCG / Players Committee YouTube (14 July 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20221006131826/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wlwWvl1F-1s Internet Archive].</ref> The Players Committee YouTube description names him Erik "DOA" Lonnquist.
